limitations: 4.10 executes a finite gain-delay candidate scan and noninvasiveness examples; it does not certify shooting/Floquet-verified UPO stabilization.
Finite-time chaos indicators, sampled recurrence geometry and multifractal estimates do not certify asymptotic chaos or attractor dimensions.
Shadowing compares numerical candidates with refined numerical references; it is not a true-orbit existence proof.
Normalized Mathieu/Duffing/Van der Pol axes are distinct from SI time; mixed-coordinate/canonical-volume conventions and estimator limitations remain explicit.
Worker validation checks bounded structure, finite values, units/input lineage; it does not authenticate arbitrary manipulated finite scientific values.
No physical-device, Firefox/WebKit or screen-reader-audio certification was performed.

metadata.reason: The first S19 Chromium test exceeded its unchanged 30s budget. The already-failed run was stopped after verifying the exact task-owned runner15264 command and all descendants; no user process or file was removed. The JSON reporter had not finalized; no partial JSON result is accepted.

priorQuietFullPass.sourceAssociation: S26-progress.md execution record; native report start is independently checked within the CP4-F-to-CP4-P interval.

resolvedItems: Initial incomplete imports/types, equation grammar and symbol definitions, helper-fixture copy, and body failure-case wording were corrected without weakening required checks.
Reentrant cancellation before worker start, normalized-axis wording, scatter-mode validation and stale-result display were corrected with targeted regression evidence.
Distinct plot patterns and recurrence-display sampling bias were corrected; native numerical results were preserved.
Sandbox process EPERM was recovered with the same approved command; dev CSP failures were verified using production builds without relaxing CSP.
Export log-directory/format-report placement and a slow task-owned Git reader were tooling issues recorded in progress, not counted as final passing product results.

Initial final verification ran under concurrent CPU/resource contention and was rejected. Its full Vitest, new-browser and regression reports remain preserved above; none is counted as passing completion evidence.

CP4-F replaces an aggregate beforeAll computation in the new nonlinear science test with lazy per-unit caching. The native assertions, numerical budgets, existing tests/scanner/baseline, test timeouts and product/content/E2E/PNG source remain unchanged from CP4-V.
The unchanged legacy inventory passed a quiet isolated diagnostic rerun. Exact diagnostics, failures and execution commands are recorded in S26-progress.md.

A later isolated browser run exposed actual duplicate copying of Pyragas history: runNative discarded each already-detached simulation.step() sample and took another snapshot. The retained duplicate-snapshot report was rejected without increasing the five-second completion expectation or thirty-second test limit.

The final-source combined browser run with two workers encountered a preserved historical S19 thirty-second timeout while S18 ran concurrently and was rejected. The final original 120-test report must pass with one worker and no concurrent heavy checks; all test/expect timeouts, retries, snapshots and comparison thresholds remain unchanged.

A subsequent one-worker run also exceeded the original S19 deadline and was stopped as an already-failed task-owned attempt. Its non-finalized JSON is not accepted; archived log, error context and trace are hash-verified separately. Trace review found substantial browser/context/page setup costs and a late AxeBuilder blank-page creation. A reviewed temporary wrapper disables diagnostic video recording only; its contents/hash and unchanged original configuration are recorded, and the original two-project S19 probe and final 120 journeys must independently pass. This does not claim that video was the sole timeout cause.

The helper-only optimization consumes the existing detached step sample. Its exact ten-unit JSON/input/progress equivalence proof is checked above. Completion requires all final full-suite, quality/build, golden, secret and browser evidence from the final optimized source.
